title: Publish and public media delivery enforce element-compatible MIME roles

security_finding.reproduction: The initial regression test uploaded valid image/video/audio records and demonstrated that validatePublicationAssets returned null for a video asset assigned to a Card image field. Published media access also lacked image MIME checks for Card, gallery/carousel, poster and background references, so a valid media ID in the wrong field could bypass the UI picker filter.
security_finding.impact: A mismatched asset could be accepted by Publish, render as a broken image, and in some image-only fields grant public delivery to otherwise private audio/video bytes.
security_finding.fix: Publication validation derives media roles from typed node fields and requires image, audio or video MIME support accordingly. Public delivery repeats the role check for image elements, Card images, gallery/carousel items, video posters and root/node backgrounds; mismatched references fail closed. Save continues to preserve private drafts and only Publish rejects the mismatch.
security_finding.third_party_review: No external implementation was needed. The accepted MIME types and media roles are repository-owned contracts; a new dependency would add no useful capability.
